# Synthetic spreadsheet fixtures

`date.xls`, `date.xlsb` and `date.ods` are the synthetic date-format fixtures from
[calamine v0.36.1](https://github.com/tafia/calamine/tree/v0.36.1/tests), distributed
under the accompanying MIT licence. They verify the native import readers for
legacy Excel, binary Excel and OpenDocument spreadsheets. They contain synthetic
cell values rather than user data.
